notes:
Summary: Large mid-market industrial automation shop interested in using Redwood for on-floor operator assistants, document search for maintenance manuals, and predictive maintenance alerting. Project progressed to procurement but paused due to company-wide hiring freeze and a near-term budget hold. Deal placed on ice by CFO/Finance.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-08-19: Lead created after tech conference — AE outreach (Morgan Ellis).
- 2025-09-03: Discovery call with Head of Automation (Alejandra Ruiz) — confirmed use cases + latency targets (50-150ms p50 for short chat flows, batch embed jobs for nightly analytics).
- 2025-10-14: Product demo + architecture review (Priya Nair attended). Discussed Dedicated vs Private.
- 2025-11-20: Security questionnaire submitted; asked for SOC2, SSO/SAML, KMS, and data residency details. Provided Redwood security deck (drive:/security/ceres/security-qa.docx).
- 2026-01-18: POC kickoff (test fleet on a 2-week private deployment in their staging VPC). POC included operator assistant prototype and embedding-based doc search.
- 2026-02-10: POC review — strong technical fit. SE notes: quantization profile recommended for 8-bit dedicated nodes; batching reduced token cost by ~28%.
- 2026-02-14: Last business touchpoint — CFO emailed: "All external initiatives frozen until Q3 hiring decisions are final".

Call notes / quotes: 
- CTO (Raj Patel): "Great fit technically, but headcount and capital are locked down until we see the Q3 plan."
- Head of Automation: "We want the private deployment for compliance — can't use hosted for control systems at present."

Requirements summary: 
- Workloads: operator chat (low-latency), nightly embedding pipelines for manuals, reranking for SOP retrieval.
- Latency/throughput: p50 50-150ms for short-turn chat; overnight embedding throughput ~200k docs/week.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity but needs predictable unit economics.
- Model preferences: foundation open models or verified Redwood catalog; ability to pin versions for safety.
- Routing/fallback: require fallbacks to smaller quantized variants when load spikes.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logging retained 1 year, KMS key control, on-prem or VPC-only deployment, data residency NA.

POC outcome: Technical thumbs-up from SE/architects. Business approval on hold.

Next steps and open items: 
- RECORD: Deal moved to "paused" due to corporate budget/hiring freeze.
- Action: Follow-up planned after Q3 planning window (target Aug 2026) — calendar task created but no champion to move internally.
- Risk: Without internal champion (Head of Automation stretched thin), likely to slip further. If budget re-opens, may revisit Dedicated + Private bundle.

Stalled reason tags: budget freeze; hiring freeze; no internal champion.

Suggested playbook: 
- Keep technical docs and POC artifacts in hand; schedule quarterly check-ins rather than weekly outreach.
- Offer a limited-time pilot credit to keep engagement warm when budget clears (subject to AE approval).
- Nurture Head of Automation and SE contact; attempt to surface an internal sponsor in Finance if possible.

Metadata: last qualified ARR estimate $50-150k; likely 12–18 month adoption timeline once budget returns.
short_description: Procurement-stage mid-market industrial automation account. Strong technical fit after POC, but procurement paused due to company-wide hiring/budget freeze. Monitoring; follow up after Q3 budget decisions.
